sections.title: Account profile, avatar and deletion
features: Google account sign-in through the existing website client, native system browser, fixed app callback and one-use S256-bound mobile exchange. No separate Google iOS client is needed.

Photo library selection/cancellation, square crop, JPEG/PNG/WebP,4 MiB, 64 to 6000 pixel validation, multipart upload, initials fallback for absent or broken image.
Destructive account deletion confirmation, confirmed server response, generation-bound session clearing.

Deletion is soft delete, revokes access tokens and removes hosted avatar. Public contributions can remain or transfer. Google login can restore the account. Native copy does not promise permanent PII erasure.
Session changes discard private profile draft and asynchronous stale responses cannot adopt another account.

Administrator password sign-in initializes expanded for account mode=superadmin, reuses the strict Google/mobile DTO and Keychain adoption path, clears password after each attempt and respects server Retry-After.
Canonical production Keychain/SQLite names remain unchanged; every other HTTPS origin uses full SHA256-scoped personal storage, device and game identities.
